summary.text: Darrick Law is the Republican candidate for Minnesota State Senate District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Jen McEwen (D).
In a Ballotpedia survey, Law said her background is in marketing and sales and that she has lived in Duluth since 2022.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Darrick Law described herself as a lifelong Minnesotan who made Duluth her home in 2022, with a professional background in marketing and sales and ten years as a makeup artist running a small business.
She said she is running because most people hold a range of views somewhere in the middle and want a representative who weighs what is best for their communities.
Law named bipartisan efforts on the state budget, lower taxes and stopping fraud, and consumer protections against artificial intelligence, as her key campaign messages.
She listed consumer protections, and energy and environmental protections, as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
